{{Quote|On behalf of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, I hereby grant you the title 'Millionaire'.|Ozzmos Roberts, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:OR" />}}
'''Ozzmos Roberts''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Banker/Legends|banker]] worked for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Roberts visited the small desert town of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he tried to persuade rich beings to open savings accounts with the Banking Clan.<ref name="SWG:OR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ozzmos Roberts was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ozzmos Roberts was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 9|Game Update 9]],<ref name="SWG:OR" /> on [[April 30]], [[2009]]. He was one of the three NPCs (along with [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lt.]] [[Jarad Gastin]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Caleb Knolar]]) added with the update that were used as [[:wikipedia:Gold sink|credit sinks]] to remove money from the game economy and combat inflation.<ref name="GU9">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=908618|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 9}}</ref> For paying one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] the player receives the player title "Millionaire", for one billion credits the title "Billionaire".<ref name="SWG:OR" />

Ozzmos is the nickname of a member of [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's Quality Assurance team.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/user/profile.m?user_id=363279|text=All about Ozzmos}}</ref>
